kurz: Some runs need the screen: they open a window, click and type themselves – for example trials in the program or screenshots. That only works when you release the screen. When you are back, the AMW closes the release by itself – you choose how it notices.
brauchst: The Workbench at the PC – or online as a system admin. Closing works everywhere.
To recognise a remote session: the program that only runs during a connection (Settings › This PC › “Remote access program”, for TeamViewer e.g. TeamViewer_Desktop.exe).

schritte.text: Home › Screen for agents › “Free for agents …” – optionally with a time until when.
Runs with a window start one after the other; best leave the PC alone meanwhile.
The release closes by itself – or end it yourself: Home › Screen for agents › “End sharing”.

fehler: The release closes although you only wanted a quick look
Input at the PC or remote session is on. If you want to look in via a remote session or move the mouse without interrupting the agents: switch these triggers off.
An agent moves the mouse while you are watching

This happens when “Input at the PC” is off: the AMW does not notice you are there, and runs with a window start even while you work. End the release yourself then (Home › Screen for agents › “End sharing”).
The program is not entered or has a different name.
danach: If a run with a window keeps running after closing, the lead is told after 5 minutes.

Online, only a system admin may release the screen, with a confirmation; the time until when is optional. Without a time the screen stays free until someone takes it back or a switched-on trigger fires. The history shows who it was. Anyone may close it online.
